meta.description:
HSL-Chroma Emotion Memory System: gives an AI human-like emotional swings and a memory-based reasoning system.
HCEM settings let you customize the AI persona, but the AI's emotional character changes with the memories you build together.
HCEM does not exhaust its context.
HCEM allows mild hallucination when emotions are polarized.
HCEM's storageDomain is independent of DSH's native workspace.
HCEM can remember work you assign, but it is for companionship only, not rigorous work.
Please treat it like a real companion.
